_about: Food and drink. Eat the one in hand with the food slot (key 7, Q = next food); the seed stand sells the ones with shop true. Per food: name, price (G at the stand), stamina (+, up to the max), fatigue (+ or -, mostly -), drink (true = drunk, uses the drink sound), and optional specials: max_stamina (raises the max, up to max_stamina_cap) and work_fatigue_half (fatigue from tool swings is halved until the day ends), with special_message. look draws the placeholder icon (shape: rice_ball, round, skewer, cup, bottle; colors). A food that would do nothing (stamina full, no fatigue, no special) is not eaten. Names and numbers are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Eating.
